rows.exact_scope: One fixed operation: split sourcev into adjacentu,w; disjoint nonempty parts ofcompleteN(v), no other oldedge change. Eight actualsources acrossD3/D4/D5; every sourcevertex and unorderedpart completed. Separate capacity proof excludes specifiedotherdegree targets without fake enumeration.
positive_guarantees: 旧点度不变，新两点度由part大小+1精确控制。
newroot条件只作必要筛；若通过才检查oldold和producer全图BFS，不冒充整图成功。

rows.remaining_gap: Other nonisomorphic253/810/104/441/684/650/1518/2810sources and general targetorder graphs remain open. Multi-split, overlapping attachments and other oldedge changes are different mechanisms, not excluded here.
rows.lesson: 按NB根容量选择参数，容量过线后还要每个最远层目标能从两侧首步到达。当前实际源存在独占首步远目标，邻集不能仅靠相邻两点分开。按约暂停该方向；只在明确改变连接机制或取得有不同覆盖结构的新source时重开，不续seed/局部bad优化或自动跨case。

rows.title: 固定三base七port m50严格闭域：26+3×8支持，32tiling全缺0→1路线
rows.method_family: Affine lift with typed inverse ports

goal.baseline_date: 2026-11-01 bounded primary-source derived guarantee; global/priority uncertified

rows.diameter_scope: 固定三baseA/B/S/T/R、simple七port、m50完整A³严格排除；fullF11³无intrafi边lift亦失败，非一般7D3上界。
rows.distance_text: R只base0 half、交换base1/2避旧S/T重复。实际1029词counts=[[50,64,64],[64,52,56],[64,56,52]]，只该topology evenm≤50。m50 root00必须50型无重复，独立symbolicidentity给26base+三8块；a0归一2/10，d三值排序保图。4802outer全域、844可行base、3736blocks、8140pairnodes，32root00tiling全在0→1失败，0未试/0完整controller。含prepare/编译/identity .919086454CPU。
rows.exact_scope: 仅此三base拓扑m50、simple和完整A³；旧mod10 passingprofile是必要门旧OPEN，已被本次完整exactcover严格终态覆盖。smaller evenm≤48开放，无自动48/46/44梯子；非所有七port或其他F11机制排除。
positive_guarantees: 事前symbolic最小>36获支持、实际50，使最高端m50成为明确有限门。
50真实wordforms与26+三8块逐整数向量相等；不重复旧residue枚举。
缺三walk的0→1 pair非邻（相邻总有backtrack三walk）；继承障碍代入F11，两步至多7×121=847<1331，故此固定fullfiber确不D3；非新普适定理。
rows.remaining_gap: m50严格失败；同topology evenm≤48/其他拓扑开放，不自动降模数。
rows.lesson: 同层可行32对象均无法同时补0→1，缺的是兼容路线；停止最高端，改四base生成规则且保B三角，再过symbolic/公开门做一次global批次，避免按坏对微降续算。

rows.diameter_scope: 固定四base m33/e11有限global参数采样；0完整controller witness/图；非全族排除。
rows.distance_text: 【最新竞争状态】公开W(7)33推论181450超过条件175692共5758；原+5942仅当时15点检索历史。A四循环，B在012零电压三循环、base3平移m/3；S/T/R三无固定base匹配。实际1372词16类最小51、3|m，当时按旧门选择m33/H132条件175692。实际batch用a3=0 gauge、保e11单位五轨[1,2,3,11,22]各400000，共2000000合法，seed2026110107、16191788原PRNG输出。终态UNKNOWN_SAMPLE_CAP_REACHED，0witness，含编译1.822285705CPU<30。首(3,3)失败1962566，02:36946/11:386/01:84/12:15/03:3；37434过首门、488过02，最后3在03止。
rows.exact_scope: 单固定topology/Z33、归一branch内合法global随机样本；非全域穷举/非family排除。24MB按序实际attempt记录保存；因无witness未执行132controller与17424pairword导出。unusedCPU不自动授权下一批。
positive_guarantees: 每候选独立生成，覆盖反馈不改变下一候选，0hillclimb。
rows.remaining_gap: 原topology m33全族存在性未排；但其H132完整F11点数即使成功也已被公开181450阻断。三固定mod11 profile的phase修复已严格失败，其他quotient未排。triangle123受控单例成功修一桶却破坏其他类，0完整controller/图。
rows.lesson: 本次明确区分缺路线容量与共享相位不兼容：profile3六桶各仅2种形式，profile1/2各完整phase cube均无解、保首八类仅两同构相位仍缺03。改triangle123闭合可补23目标桶但使五个原满类失效，不能由总缺12→10自动续。更强公开181450现停止m33竞争派发；不据此判全部七port无望，不自动m36梯子。

graph_count_scope: Legacy valid_new_graph_examples/improved and confirmed_publictable_* counters track improvements over preserved saved-main-table baselines, not current global records. validated_named_* counts all accepted named graphs. Current publicly dominated examples form a separate, possibly overlapping set. Compatibility nonrecord/pending fields only classify examples outside the saved-table-improvement set; neither they nor the table counters certify current global novelty of the old11/12 families.
formal_count_scope: Complete fixed deterministic-formula Lean graph witnesses; literal edge-text parsing equality and exact regularity are separate fields. Historical confirmed-public-table graph formal count remains separate.
validated_nonrecord_scope: Compatibility fields count explicitly classified nonrecord examples outside the saved-main-table-improvement set only; not all publicly dominated project examples. See known_publicly_dominated_* for the full currently established comparison set.
known_publicly_dominated_scope: Accepted named graph instances with an explicitly checked larger public construction. May overlap confirmed saved-main-table improvements. This field does not certify global novelty of any other parameter or graph.
novelty_pending_scope: Compatibility novelty_pending_* fields concern accepted named graphs outside the saved-main-table-improvement set only. Historical table-relative improvements are not thereby certified as global records.
confirmed_publictable_scope: Comparison against preserved saved-main-table values at their recorded dates; not a certification of latest global records.
